description: Source code for managing boards within the focalboard application, including CRUD operations, duplication, membership management, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: GetBoard
methods.description: Retrieves a board by its ID.

methods.name: GetBoardCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of boards.

methods.name: GetBoardMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific board, including descendant modification times and last modified info.

methods.name: getBoardForBlock
methods.description: Returns the board that owns a specific block.

methods.name: getBoardHistory
methods.description: Fetches the historical record of a board, either latest or previous.

methods.name: getBoardDescendantModifiedInfo
methods.description: Provides timestamp and user info for the last or first modification of a board or its descendants.

methods.name: setBoardCategoryFromSource
methods.description: Sets the category of a destination board based on a source board's category.

methods.name: DuplicateBoard
methods.description: Duplicates a board along with its blocks and members, optionally as a template.

methods.name: GetBoardsForUserAndTeam
methods.description: Retrieves boards associated with a user and team, including public boards if specified.

methods.name: GetTemplateBoards
methods.description: Fetches template boards for a team and user.

methods.name: CreateBoard
methods.description: Creates a new board, optionally adding the creator as a member.

methods.name: addBoardsToDefaultCategory
methods.description: Adds boards to the default category for a user within a team.

methods.name: PatchBoard
methods.description: Updates properties of a board, handles linked/unlinked messages, and broadcasts changes.

methods.name: DeleteBoard
methods.description: Deletes a board and broadcasts the deletion.

methods.name: GetMembersForBoard
methods.description: Retrieves members associated with a board.

methods.name: GetMembersForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all boards members for a user.

methods.name: GetMemberForBoard
methods.description: Gets a specific member's info for a board.

methods.name: AddMemberToBoard
methods.description: Adds a user as a member to a board, managing permissions and broadcasting.

methods.name: UpdateBoardMember
methods.description: Updates a board member, ensuring at least one admin remains.

methods.name: isLastAdmin
methods.description: Checks if a user is the last admin on a board.

methods.name: DeleteBoardMember
methods.description: Removes a user from a board's members, with admin checks.

methods.name: SearchBoardsForUser
methods.description: Searches for boards for a user based on a term and field.

methods.name: SearchBoardsForUserInTeam
methods.description: Searches for boards within a team for a user.

methods.name: UndeleteBoard
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted board and broadcasts the change.
